title: Flatten a Multilevel Doubly Linked List
problemStatement: A doubly linked list may contain child pointers that point to separate doubly linked lists. Flatten the multilevel structure into a single-level doubly linked list. The child lists should appear immediately after their parent nodes, and all child pointers must become null. Return the head of the flattened list.
constraints: Number of nodes is in the range [0, 1000].
